name: Ufos
overview: Scripture reveals encounters with extraordinary beings and phenomena that some might associate with UFOs, emphasizing God's sovereign control over all heavenly and earthly realms. The mysterious 'sons of God' and their offspring, mighty men of renown, illustrate divine and earthly interaction (Genesis 6:4), while visions of fiery clouds, whirlwinds, and heavenly chariots filled with angels underscore God's majestic presence and power (Ezekiel 1:4; Psalms 68:17). Prophetic imagery of figures coming with the clouds of heaven points to the divine Son of Man, affirming that supernatural appearances ultimately serve God's redemptive purposes (Daniel 7:13). These passages invite believers to recognize that any such phenomena are under God's authority and are part of His sovereign plan.
